_readme: Copy of this file lives at config.local.json (git-ignored). Put your real family words ONLY in the local copy. Each phrase may name its own language (en, hi, es, zh, fr, ar, pt; default: language below), speaker (any label: it never leaves your Mac), kind (scripted, unscripted, whisper, white_noise, noise, code_switched, wrong_language) and group (Arabic dialect group, or pt-BR / pt-PT). README section 7.
